description: Routes situations to skills so they fire without a slash command, and holds the agent to the routing it was given. The .claude/verify.sh Stop gate is NOT in this lane: it refuses to run an untrusted gate and tells the operator to run `vstack trust`, a command only the full install provides. A hook whose only outcome is naming a command you do not have is not a feature of this lane. goal-gate.sh IS in this lane: it only reads .goal/*/goal.md and never executes anything out of the repo, so it needs no trust entry.
